summary: Learn programme risk governance and escalation with risk matrices, KRIs, board reporting, and practical escalation workflows. Enrol now.
lede: Programme risk governance training covers setting risk appetite and escalation thresholds, assigning ownership, and reporting breaches for decisions. For professionals involved in programme oversight, risk reporting or governance forums, it offers practice designing escalation matrices, tracking controls and dependencies, and preparing board or committee papers. Participants also work with key risk indicators, assurance and root cause analysis to clarify actions when limits are approached or controls fail.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with risk reporting, programme oversight, or governance forums and need a more disciplined escalation process. It fits roles that handle exceptions, control breaches, board packs, or assurance workflows across programmes and portfolios.
prerequisites: You should bring working familiarity with programme or project governance, risk registers, issue logs, or management reporting. A laptop is recommended for working on templates and digital tracking exercises, and it helps to have a sample board paper, escalation log, or KRI report from your own environment for adaptation.
